intro.title: Blue Sapphire Bracelets
intro.description: Exclusive collection of beautiful Blue Sapphire Bracelets from Gems & Jewels. Blue Sapphire Gemstone is one of the rarest and hence dearest amongst all Gemstones. Blue Sapphire is an ancient stone, found in shades of blue and purple. Blue Sapphire or Neelam is considered one of the most powerful Gemstone. The Chakra associated with Blue Sapphire is Ajna Chakra and the ruling Planet is Shani Dev or Planet Saturn. Blue Sapphire blesses the wearer with intuition, good fortune, wealth, clarity of thoughts and more.
